evidence.supports: The paper defines the random-effects objective and Laplace approximation for the marginal likelihood.
CppAD tapes and repeated automatic differentiation drive objective gradients and uncertainty calculations.
The package design connects R control, user templates, CppAD tapes, sparse matrices, and optimizers.
Case studies compare TMB and ADMB estimates, timings, and speedups.
The tool is general when the user supplies a defensible joint likelihood and Laplace approximation is appropriate.
